The '''Shed''' is a type of [[Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|farm building]] purchasable from [[Robin]] at the [[Carpenter's Shop]]. A shed can also be upgraded to a Big Shed at the Carpenter's Shop. To upgrade this building fully it would cost {{Price|35000}}. If purchasing the materials, it would cost {{Price|49500}} during year 1 or {{Price|107500}} during year 2+. ==Behavior== Sheds act like small farmhouses, allowing players a room inside to decorate however they'd like with [[furniture]], [[wallpaper]], and [[flooring]]. The exterior is 7x3, smaller than its unupgraded 11x9 interior. The interior of the upgraded Big Shed is 17x12. This allows the player to effectively redistribute space on the farm. ==Interior== The initial interior of the shed is bare. The interior dimensions of the shed are 11x9, which is approximately the same size as the player's starting [[farmhouse]]. The Big Shed has dimensions of 17x12, providing slightly more than twice the area of the starting shed. Note that the "optimal layout" images below apply to mouse/keyboard. Equipment in the corners usually cannot be reached when using a controller. Shed Inside.png|The interior of a Shed. Big Shed Inside.png|The interior of a Big Shed. Optimal shed layout.png|The optimal Shed layout provides 67 spaces. Optimal big shed layout.png|The optimal Big Shed layout provides 137 spaces. Optimal Big Shed Layout Iridium Scythe.png|The optimal Big Shed layout provides 168 spaces for [[Garden Pot|Garden Pots]] harvestable by [[Iridium Scythe]]. Lights may be placed in the remaining inaccessible spaces. ==Notes== The optimal layout of an unupgraded shed provides 67 spaces, but sheds are not the only farm buildings that can be used purely for storage. A [[Barn]] provides 90 spaces, and a Deluxe Barn provides 136 spaces. [[Coop]]s and [[Cabin]]s can also be used purely for storage. Cabins provide 42 spaces when unclaimed, 113 spaces after a single upgrade, and 351 spaces after two upgrades. ==History== {{History|1.1|Introduced.}} {{History|1.3.36|Doorway centered.}} {{History|1.4|Big Shed introduced.}} {{NavboxBuildings}} [[Category:Farm buildings]] [[de:Schuppen]] [[es:Cabaña]] [[fr:Cabanon]] [[it:Rimessa]] [[ja:納屋]] [[ko:헛간]] [[hu:Raktár]] [[pt:Galpão]] [[ru:Сарай]] [[tr:Baraka]] [[zh:小屋]]
